function.of_item:
Your Plant :
To correctly install front grill fitment as per BIW design specifications.

Ship to Plant : 

End User : 
1. Allow airflow to the radiator, condenser, and engine compartment
2. Protect cooling components from debris, stones, insects
3. Provide vehicle styling and brand identity
function.of_step: SELECTION OF PART AS PER MODEL
function.of_work_element:
1. Man: 
1. TAKE THE FRONT GRILL FROM THE STORAGE AREA AND SCAN THE PART
2. INSERT & 
ALIGN THE FRONT GRILL WITH BIW AND THEN TIGHT WITH BOLTS AND PUSHPINS

2. Machine:
Proper torquing with 4NM

3. Material (Indirect) :
Hand Gloves, Apron

4. Method:
1. Install Front grill from sequencing trolley and scan
2. Align with BIW and tight with bolts & pushpins

failure.effect:
Your Plant:
1. Wrong front grill variant installed
2. FURTHER OPERATION NOT POSSIBLE
3. Gaps or scratches on grill 

Ship to Plant : Nil

End User:
1. Water/dust ingress affecting sensor
2. Customer dissatisfaction
3. Bad appereance of vehicle
failure.cause:
Sequence not followed by operator,
SEQUENCING WRONG

risk.prevention_control: OPERATOR TRAINING, PART TRACEABILITY, Sequencing part
risk.detection_control:
1. SELF CHECK, 
2. CHECKMAN CHECKING,
3. VMS scanning system
risk.severity_meaning: Loss of secondary function (comfort/convenience feature stops working) (e.g. AC, infotainment fails)
risk.detection_meaning: Low chance (Manual inspection with some standard/gauge)
